title: Dot product with a coordinate unit vector
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, and let $i$ be one of the $n$ coordinates. The dot product of $x$ with the unit vector supported at $i$ is $x_i$.
